providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseDe: Hemmung der H⁺/K⁺-ATPase betrifft die Sekretion und ist keine direkte Neutralisation vorhandener Säure.
providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseEn: H⁺/K⁺-ATPase inhibition concerns secretion, not direct neutralization of existing acid.
providedResearchSources.useBoundary: Mechanism context only; no individual therapy advice, rate estimate or clinical validation of the synthetic model.

providedResearchSources.providedSections: Full treatment page, lactase products; last review February 2018
providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseDe: Lactaseprodukte unterstützen den Lactoseabbau; die Seite belegt keine pauschale Prä-/Probiotika-Wirksamkeit.
providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseEn: Lactase products assist lactose breakdown; the page is not a definition/effectiveness dossier for all pre-/probiotics.
providedResearchSources.useBoundary: Authority patient information, not a primary trial of our portions or a source for universal substitution.

providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseDe: Lebende Mikroorganismen unterscheiden sich von mikrobiellen Substraten; Wirksamkeitsaussagen sind stamm- und bedingungsbezogen.
providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseEn: Live microorganisms differ from microbial substrates; efficacy claims depend on the studied strains and conditions.
providedResearchSources.useBoundary: Only these named sections were read; no full clinical literature review or universal product approval.

providedResearchSources.publisher: Manufacturer SmPC via electronic Medicines Compendium
providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseDe: Simeticon verändert Blasengrenzflächen und fördert Zusammenfließen; dies ist keine enzymatische Hydrolyse.
providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseEn: Simeticone changes bubble interfaces and promotes coalescence; this physical action is not enzymatic hydrolysis.
providedResearchSources.useBoundary: Primary manufacturer label, not independent efficacy evidence. No doses or patient recommendation transferred.

providedResearchSources.publisher: Robert Koch Institute report hosted by BMG
providedResearchSources.providedSections: Both pages in full: Methods and Results, project 2013–2014
providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseDe: DEGS1 2008–2011, 18–79 Jahre: Siebentages-Gebrauch nach Wirkstoff unter anderem Ibuprofen 8.0 %, ASS 5.8 %, Paracetamol 5.2 %; ausschließlich OTC insgesamt von BGS98 10.0 % auf DEGS1 12.2 %.
providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseEn: DEGS1 2008–2011 adults aged 18–79: overall seven-day analgesic use by ingredient includes ibuprofen 8.0%, ASA 5.8%, paracetamol 5.2%; exclusively OTC overall changed from 10.0% in BGS98 to 12.2% in DEGS1.
providedResearchSources.useBoundary: Historical interview-based population data, n=7099/7091; ingredient figures include prescribed use and overlap is possible. Not current 2026 rates, masses, dosing or causal benefit.

providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseDe: Anwendung hängt von Wirkung und Risiken ab; ein gemeinsamer aromatischer Ring belegt keine Austauschbarkeit.
providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseEn: Analgesic application depends on effects and risks; a shared aromatic ring does not establish interchangeability.
providedResearchSources.useBoundary: Public evidence-based authority information, not a primary trial or product-specific comparison for fictional X/Y.

providedResearchSources.providedSections: Full label, Active ingredient/Purpose; update 4 December 2025
providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseDe: Der genannte Wirkstoff ist Calciumcarbonat; die Identität liefert keine Nebenwirkungsrate einer Modellreaktion.
providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseEn: The labelled active ingredient is calcium carbonate; identity alone provides no adverse-event rate for a model reaction.
providedResearchSources.useBoundary: Submitted label, not an FDA approval claim or trial. Never use it alone as a source for belching/fullness incidence.

providedResearchSources.publisher: Manufacturer SmPC via electronic Medicines Compendium
providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseDe: Genannt sind Calciumcarbonat, Magnesiumcarbonat und Simeticon; mögliche Magen-Darm-Nebenwirkungen bestimmen keine Modellhäufigkeit.
providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseEn: Calcium carbonate, magnesium carbonate and simeticone are listed; possible gastrointestinal adverse reactions do not establish a model-specific incidence.
providedResearchSources.useBoundary: The product contains magnesium carbonate, not the magnesium hydroxide calculation portion. Manufacturer spontaneous-report text has no transferable incidence denominator.

providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseDe: Neutralisation unterscheidet sich von Alginatbarrieren; mögliche Folgen umfassen Blähungen und veränderten Stuhlgang.
providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseEn: Neutralization differs from an alginate barrier; possible effects include wind and altered bowel habit.
providedResearchSources.useBoundary: Authority guidance, not primary event-rate data; review date disclosed, no current individual treatment recommendation.

providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseDe: Das Label verbindet Ibuprofen mit COX/Prostaglandinen und kennzeichnet unvollständiges Mechanismuswissen.
providedResearchSources.providedParaphraseEn: The label links ibuprofen action with COX/prostaglandins while noting incomplete mechanistic understanding.
providedResearchSources.useBoundary: Historical 2021 mechanism source only, not a current label/dosing recommendation or evidence for every analgesic.
